episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the ongoing dispute between Compass, Zillow, and MLS, highlighting the implications for agents and the need for advocacy. He shares innovative uses of AI to solve real estate challenges, such as offering cancellation insurance to sellers and automating industry news gathering. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to leverage technology to improve their business operations.
